topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't stop thinking about it. How could things just... change like that? We used to talk every day, share everything. I remember all those little moments, the secrets we kept, the dreams we had. But now, it's like none of it ever mattered. It's not just that we've grown apart—that happens. But to have someone who knew you so well, to have them look at you and not see everything you once were to each other... It feels like part of me is missing, like a chapter in my life has been erased. I keep trying to bring it up, to maybe jog their memory, but it’s clear it's not coming back. I just wish I understood why things have to be this way.
